cases.name: valid
cases.description: consistent, unexpired metadata; release and artifacts verify

cases.name: replayed-old-snapshot
cases.description: client saw the newer timestamp/snapshot; an attacker replays the older signed set

cases.name: expired-timestamp
cases.description: timestamp.json expired before verifyAt (freeze attack or stale repository)

cases.name: forged-target-hash
cases.description: a target hash was changed after signing: targets signature no longer verifies

cases.name: corrupt-download
cases.description: artifact bytes flipped: length matches, hash does not

cases.name: wrong-length
cases.description: artifact has extra trailing bytes (endless-data style)

cases.name: rotated-root
cases.description: root v2 signed by old and new root keys; all role keys rotated
